title: Catch-up tracker row
description: One row of a catch-up tracker CSV: one account, one month. Every CSV cell is a string. Cross-row rules (the balance chain, missing months, order of work) are in rules/tracker-rules.csv.

Account.description: Account name with the last four digits, e.g. Checking 2201. Same spelling on every row.

Month.description: Statement month, YYYY-MM. The earliest row per account is the last month you trust.

Statement received.description: Yes once the PDF statement is in hand.

Printed opening.description: Opening balance printed on the statement. Blank on the trusted row.

Printed closing.description: Closing balance printed on the statement. For cards, the amount owed.

Imported.description: Yes once the month's transactions are recorded in the books.

Reconciled.description: Yes only when Books closing equals Printed closing.

Books closing.description: Closing balance the books show for this account and month.
